method: Three independent hosted runners, each four fresh-process A0 LC B1 RAW B2 RAW A3 LC phases; 12 batches preload, 84 later-time batches ingested with natural merges ON and one closed-loop native reader. Native query fixed to first 12 batches for invariant independent avg-by(scope) oracle. Only fully overlapping requests are counted, 58-83 per phase. Each runner has distinct baseline drift <=25% and all source SHA, scripts, oracle and part count checks. Strict CI reducer also stratifies queries by four equal insert-progress intervals.
math_bound: Each phase performs the same native PromQL expression and inserts identical 96 batches. The fixed query depends only on samples in first 12 batches; later samples cannot change the oracle. Within each hosted runner compare mean p95 of RAW B1/B2 to LC A0/A3. A/A drift <=25%; the RAW improvement must exceed max(5%, observed control drift) on all three independent runners, else no effect accepted. Cross-host absolute p95 cannot be pooled.

official_reduction_ci.zip_note: reducer report ZIP hashes of locally repacked content, official ZIP digest values stored here and in source-artifacts.txt

limitations: Closed-loop reader: faster candidate gets more queries in same write interval; unequal QPS may affect p95 and CPU. Do not claim isolated CPU change or production read p95 until fixed request schedule.
Read p95 from 58–83 fully overlapping queries per phase; time-of-ingest distribution differs by mode. Four equal-progress quartiles were checked; quartile p95 may be noisy with 11-23 requests.
Same unoptimized stock O1/glibc build, small pinned synthetic 96-batch workload, no external VM/EBS workload, not production jemalloc.
Mixed process CPU includes query execution, INSERT and natural merges; it is INCONCLUSIVE across hosts despite p95 reduction.
Observation of two late quartile improvements does not demonstrate mechanism or operator attribution.

next_action.step: Use the same immutable stock O1 binary and fixture in a fixed per-batch wall clock cadence and fixed native query schedule (one request each two batches). Repeat fresh LC/RAW/RAW/LC phases with exact progress strata and one-to-one request counts. Reject missed schedule deadlines and A/A drift >25% before claiming a fixed-QPS p95 benefit; study memory/CPU separately.
next_action.stop_condition: No performance claim if schedule deadlines fail or workload differs; record the complete failure and stop.
